subject: Do you ever get different results using NDEBUG=TRUE? How about more accurate ones?

messages.author: 4e78013477145d7d
messages.subject: Do you ever get different results using NDEBUG=TRUE? How about more accurate ones?
parts:
I've been trying Stan 2.6.0 to re-run some estimates from last year.
This year's runs are significantly slower, and get somewhat different results.
The old results are very consistent with estimates from other software.

Here are two strange things I've noticed when I set NDEBUG=TRUE.

First, it doesn't speed up the runs at all (let alone to what I was getting before).

Second, and this is the really strange thing...I *think* that I'm getting
better estimates with NDEBUG=TRUE.

Has anyone seen that before?
